reason: As someone burned by the first campaign and short on spare cash, B answers my doubts: it names the Majestic, shows $36,000 already committed so only $49,000 is left, firmly guarantees refunds, gives a Thanksgiving reopening, admits the roof and film risks, and promises spending reports. A has unfilled placeholders and a bracketed, tentative refund line, which makes it feel unfinished and less trustworthy.
